Added automatically from The Villager (Farmingdale) - live music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Most likely the Bay Shore guitarist Johnny "Irish" Borland (stage name Johnny Irish): every listing is a South Shore Long Island bar, and his SoundCloud names Bay Shore. No official website or booking page found. TikTok johnnyirishnyc matched by name + #johnnyirishli tag + acoustic-cover content, but it is not linked from any official page, so confirm before publishing. An Instagram handle '@johnnyirishli' shows up in a people-search listing but could not be checked (not recorded). The SoundCloud page is old and inactive. Not to be confused with Facebook 'John Irish-Musician' (a New Hampshire 603 area-code performer) or Irish fiddle act 'Johnny Irish Murphy'.
description: Solo acoustic singer and guitarist from Bay Shore who plays cover sets, mostly classic rock and '70s favorites, at bars and restaurants on Long Island's South Shore.

evidence.note: The Villager (Farmingdale) lists 'Live Music: Johnny Irish'.
The Harp & Hound lists Johnny Irish performing live on Sep 12, 2026; he also appears on Oakdale Brew House and The Wharf Oakdale calendars.

Apple Music lists Johnny "Irish" Borland as a featured guitarist on a 2022 single; a Huntington Patch listing calls Johnny "Irish" Borland a local guitarist.
